# thousandeyes_alert_suppression_window (Resource)

Retrieve alert suppression window.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `duration` (Number) Duration in seconds the suppression window is active.
- `end_repeat` (Attributes) End repeat options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--end_repeat))
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Set to `false` for `disabled`, `true` for `enabled`.
- `name` (String) Name of the alert suppression window.
- `repeat` (Attributes) Repeat options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repeat))
- `start_date` (String) The date/time when the alert suppression window starts (ISO date-time format).
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the alert suppression window. Named `id` per the import convention; the wire field stays alertSuppressionWindowId.
- `status` (String) Indicates the current status of the suppression window.
- `tests` (Attributes Set) List of tests assigned to the alert suppression window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tests))

<a id="nestedatt--end_repeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `end_repeat`

Optional:

- `count` (Number) End repeat after number of occurrences, only valid with count type option.
- `date` (String) End repeat after specific date, only valid with date type option (ISO date format).
- `type` (String) End repeat options type.


<a id="nestedatt--repeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repeat`

Optional:

- `days_of_week` (Set of String)
- `interval_length` (Number) Number of `intervalTypes` to wait before reactivating the alert suppression window.
- `interval_type` (String) Repeat options interval type
- `type` (String) Repeat options type.
